title: Amazon warehouse robots in service, by year

source.name: Amazon Robotics fleet milestones, as reported by trade press (Retail Dive, Sacra) and Amazon's own announcements

notes: Amazon acquired Kiva Systems in March 2012 for about $775 million and had roughly 1,400 robots in service within about two years. The fleet reportedly reached ~200,000 in 2019 and ~520,000 in 2022, before Amazon announced its one-millionth robot in 2025 (deployed across 300+ fulfillment and sortation buildings). Intermediate-year figures are secondary-press estimates, not an official annual Amazon disclosure.
